ray_data_bound_definition: active HTTP upper bound is actors x async batches; batch rows affect the declared row envelope

preserved_failures.reason: complete request mismatch: missing original logprobs=false

limitations: Four first qualifications; warmups0/repeats1/cachefalse/retry0. No speed ranking or P99 claim.
Families A and B loaded separate model service instances; matching hot state is not established.
Task timing includes arrival to usable consumer EOF; model startup and post-query audit are separate.
LIMIT5 original metric and full pre-LIMIT classification confusion are separate observations.
GPU activity is external 0.5s utilization sampling, not exact CUDA kernel time.
No prompt, labels, generation, parser or evaluator change; no repeated completed model queries.

timing_definitions.request_definition: owner proxy handler entry through response write EOF; each retained HTTP request is one observation

partition_definition.gateway_before_dispatch: received through upstream dispatch: request read and before-forward work
partition_definition.upstream_roundtrip: upstream dispatch through attempt finish: connection/pool/backend queue, serving and response transfer
partition_definition.gateway_after_upstream: attempt finish through consumer response write EOF: audit and downstream transfer

timing_definitions.scope: descriptive within-run request/operation quantiles, not stable population or query tail latency

retention.retrieval: request access from the experiment owner using run_id and archive SHA; private source/response/config archives remain outside Git
retention.published_observations: all 8480 completed original query owner-proxy HTTP timing points and all retained executor operation duration samples; no request/response bodies

parser_replay.scope: Original Filter postprocessing algorithm on existing complete HTTP content after SDK/id/row/hash equality. No provider response decoding, model generation or full vendor SDK initialization was repeated.
